description: This file defines the GenericHelperFactory class, which provides a static method to retrieve or create instances of GenericHelper based on helper information, utilizing caching and reflection to load helper classes dynamically.

classes.name: GenericHelperFactory
classes.description: Factory class for obtaining instances of GenericHelper, with caching and dynamic class loading.

methods.name: getHelper
methods.description: Retrieves a GenericHelper instance based on helperInfo, creating and caching it if necessary, using reflection to load the helper class.
